title: Standard Chartered Signs Agreement To Acquire Crypto Custodian Zodia Custody
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Standard Chartered Signs Agreement To Acquire Crypto Custodian Zodia Custody British bank Standard Chartered will integrate Zodia Custody’s bitcoin and crypto services into its own. This post Standard Chartered Signs Agreement To Acquire Crypto Custodian Zodia Custody first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
